skill_defects: SKILL.md 'Stage 1 — Intake' upload checklist asks for 'Trial balance for the period and comparatives' without saying which comparatives a 10-Q needs (prior year-end balance sheet; same quarter and year-to-date of the prior year for the income statement). A prior-year September TB is 'the period's comparative' for 9M income but not for the balance sheet, so the checklist cannot tell the validator whether such a file is in scope or the wrong period.

references/method.md 'Step 2b — Check the comparatives against what was filed' is written as an '[auto]' ledger read; on the upload path it does not say that the prior filing's period-end TB (30 June for a Q2 balance) is needed to compare a balance-sheet figure, so a quoted total-assets figure is untestable without a further upload the checklist never asks for.

references/method.md 'Outputs' and references/edge-cases.md 'A component ledger tie-out mistaken for a consolidated one' point to 'Gate 1' for the consolidated-versus-component check, which is Mosofin-path only; there is no upload-path instruction to look for investment-in-subsidiary or intercompany accounts in an uploaded TB.

SKILL.md intake row C ('Build the task list with no dates') and references/method.md 'Step 1' do not state the deadline rule (40 days for accelerated filers, next business day on a weekend), so the deadline check depends on the agent's own knowledge.
sample_defects: filing_inputs.md quotes Q2 10-Q six-month revenue of 2,598,300, but profit_and_loss_2025_ytd.csv gives Jan-Jun 2025 = 371,000 + 393,800 + 424,000 + 454,800 + 479,400 + 492,200 = 2,615,200, a 16,900 difference. The key's finding only says 'Checks comparatives', so it is unclear whether the difference is a planted finding or an error; if planted, the key should name it.
filing_inputs.md quotes total assets of 2,741,000 from the Q2 10-Q (30 June 2025), but no 30 June 2025 TB is supplied, so the comparative check on it cannot run.

The TB for a 10-Q filer carries an investment in and intercompany payable to Northbrook UK Ltd (104,800; 38,000) and no income tax lines; the key ignores both, though each changes what the tie-out can claim.
trial_balance_2025-08-31.csv is listed as a required input, but no step of a 10-Q uses an August TB (comparatives need 30 June and 31 December); it serves only preliminary analytics.
summary: PASS 3/3: calendar back from 7 Nov (deadline 10 Nov), H1 revenue 16,900 above Q2 10-Q, no draft so ledger side only; Sept 2024 TB rejected on content.
